season.name: Winter
season.line: The dark season is holy ground.

movement.name: The Hidden Seed
movement.line: What looks dormant is being kept.

days.t: God is our refuge and strength
x: God is our refuge and strength, a help in the afflictions that have come heavily upon us.
Therefore will we not fear when the earth is troubled, and the mountains are removed into the depths of the seas.

days.t: Dwelling in the help of the Most High
x: Praise of a Song, by David. He that dwells in the help of the Highest, shall sojourn under the shelter of the God of heaven.
He shall say to the Lord, Thou art my helper and my refuge: my God; I will hope in him.

days.t: My help comes from the Lord
x: A Song of Degrees. I lifted up mine eyes to the mountains, whence my help shall come.
My help [shall come] from the Lord, who made the heaven and the earth.

days.t: The name of the Lord is of great strength
x: The name of the Lord is of great strength; and the righteous running to it are exalted.

days.t: Good to those who wait on him in the day of affliction
x: The Lord is good to them that wait on him in the day of affliction; and he knows them that reverence him.
so that by two unchangeable things, in which [it is] impossible [for] God to lie, we may have strong encouragement, having fled for refuge to take hold of the hope being set before [us],
which we have as an anchor of the soul, both sure and firm and entering into that within the veil,
